note: One entry per input page. The hub reads this and the pages themselves; nothing about a page is written twice.

pages.title: Generators
pages.purpose: Four integers in, an integer curve out.
pages.inputs: degree, the generator polynomials h, u, v, and a step 1/m
pages.outputs: exact control points, the integer grid they need, the scale

pages.title: The six missing families
pages.purpose: Elastica, polynomial and sinusoidal spirals, trochoids, interpolators, rational PH.
pages.inputs: one dial per family (m, p, n, k, weights, degree)
pages.outputs: each family drawn, with its exactness status

pages.title: qAC and discrete LAC
pages.purpose: One constant past the log-aesthetic curve, and its discrete form.
pages.inputs: α and c for qAC; α and C for the discrete recurrence
pages.outputs: the two curve families, and the c = 0 check against the LAC

pages.title: Biarcs
pages.purpose: Two arcs that match two points and two tangents, joined G1.
pages.outputs: the equal-radius pair, its centres, the joint, the measured join

pages.title: Arches and pillars
pages.purpose: One section, mirrored: the join decides arch or capital.
pages.inputs: a section from the showcase, a placement, a mirror axis
pages.outputs: measured crown angle, outward divergence, and the use

pages.title: Pell and √2
pages.purpose: Integer points on x² − 2y² = 1, and the convergents of √2.
pages.inputs: none — two integer laws, and the point (3, 2)
pages.outputs: the doubling and addition chains, lattice points, the exact error law

pages.title: Discrete clothoid
pages.purpose: A clothoid built from equal chords and p-triple turns.
pages.inputs: the turn step δ, the chord count, the triple ladder
pages.outputs: the quantised schedule, its measured exponent and quantisation error

pages.title: Gen-Arch
pages.purpose: The generalized Archimedean spiral, and the radial of a LA curve.
pages.inputs: the dials a, b, c; the LA slope α maps to c = α − 1
pages.outputs: the four classical spirals, the radial identity, the dial conversions

pages.title: Catenary
pages.purpose: A hanging chain, chained from pythagorean triples.
pages.inputs: a, the split, steps per side
pages.outputs: chord walks, four-cubic fits, a 2.5D drape

pages.title: Practical curve
pages.purpose: The same study as 34 cubics instead of 1,164.
pages.outputs: a hand-off SVG at 0.42 mm worst deviation

pages.title: Curve families
pages.purpose: Spirals at dress-curve proportions.
pages.outputs: a drawn family on one sheet

pages.title: Spiral turns
pages.purpose: How many times a clothoid winds, and when windings merge.
pages.outputs: turns before the curves touch

pages.title: Branch points
pages.purpose: Where a curve may safely split.
pages.outputs: candidate branch points with their error

pages.title: Piece model and terminals
pages.purpose: A stroke that ends on purpose instead of stopping.
pages.outputs: a ribbon with rails, a mirror, and a terminal strip

pages.title: Recovered terminals
pages.purpose: 150 real ends cut out of the ornaments pages.
pages.outputs: measured taper fractions and gallery plates

pages.title: Recovered spirals
pages.purpose: Every spine path from the Stage II and LAC pages.
pages.outputs: cubics tagged line, arc, euler, logaesthetic, member

pages.title: Stage II plates
pages.purpose: The intermediate curves, as the old page drew them.
pages.outputs: 20 plates of drawn spines

pages.title: Spine on the sheet
pages.purpose: A recovered chain placed on the 200 × 250 sheet.
pages.outputs: a Piece with a declared contact at the fork

pages.title: Spine study 01
pages.purpose: Promotion gate 4: how close the chain gets to the study.
pages.outputs: 1.29 per cent drift, measured

pages.title: Ornament board
pages.purpose: 85 plates, 26 work items, 11 decisions.
pages.inputs: nothing — it is the index of the work
pages.outputs: ordering, notes and a JSON export

pages.title: Fleur studies
pages.purpose: The twenty studies, as a subpage of the board.
pages.outputs: twenty plates, all defaulted to needs work

pages.title: Fleur study 01
pages.purpose: The old grammar ported onto clothoid segments.
pages.outputs: 12 nodes within 0.030 units of the original

pages.title: Principle cards
pages.purpose: Eight cards: four primals, four archetypes.
pages.outputs: gesture, three numbers, and a not-this list

pages.title: Primal ornaments
pages.purpose: Earth, water, air, fire — one grammar each.
pages.outputs: four sketches, ahead of their gate on purpose

pages.title: Euler match
pages.purpose: Every exact curve rebuilt as a chain of chords and clothoid spans.
pages.outputs: chord count, deviation as % of size, spans per curve, grid snap

pages.title: Hearts
pages.purpose: One Euler arc, rotated until it kisses the axis, then mirrored.
pages.inputs: turns, the rotation found by tangency, where to cut
pages.outputs: a heart silhouette, and the grid cost of the cut

pages.title: Clothoid cut
pages.purpose: The eye, the equal-arc cut, and the minimum-width box.
pages.outputs: the minimum width of one half and of the full pair

pages.title: Evolute parallel
pages.purpose: Any of the classical curve families, its evolute, and the parallel involutes.
pages.inputs: a family (LAC α, roulette k, ellipse b) and the offset d
pages.outputs: the base, its evolute, and a family of parallel curves via the shared evolute

pages.title: Heart forms
pages.purpose: Five heart curves, side by side.
pages.outputs: the five shapes, each to its true extent

pages.title: Stem library
pages.purpose: 177 labelled stems, one per tight square.
pages.outputs: labelled curves to promote to flowers.html

pages.title: Stem offsets
pages.purpose: Every stalk with two rails at ±d, shown with exact, Levien fitted cubic, and LAC chain options.
pages.outputs: base, +d/-d rails, fit error and fold report, 2× separation

pages.title: Plant forms
pages.purpose: A stalk with two rails, an ending, lattice growth marks and branches that get smaller upward.
pages.inputs: a stalk, its offset, the ending choice
pages.outputs: the plant-form proof: cone/seagrass/flower endings, pyramid marks, branches

pages.title: Fleur proof 01
pages.purpose: The fleur study read through the plant-form grammar, not drawn as a special case.
pages.inputs: the study's width, its integer nodes, its petal as a branch
pages.outputs: rails, a cone terminal at the lance tip, a seagrass branch ending, pyramid marks

pages.title: Fleur grammar 01
pages.purpose: The W03 report on the ported fleur: spans, corners, seam and clearance.
pages.outputs: 26 spans, 9 corners, 2 declared seam contacts, the clearance report

pages.title: Fleur sets P01–P20
pages.purpose: The twenty parameter sets built by one grammar function, as a contact sheet.
pages.outputs: twenty cards, the parameter table, spans and corners per set

pages.title: Storey 01 · Monstrance
pages.purpose: The first W05 storey: ground, foot, stem, head, host, rays, cross.
pages.inputs: the part vocabulary and the p-triple ray fan
pages.outputs: one grounded vessel with 24 rays and its three aspects

pages.title: Storey 02 · Pillar
pages.purpose: The second W05 storey: plinth, torus, entasised shaft, capital, axis.
pages.inputs: the part vocabulary and one mirrored integer cubic profile
pages.outputs: one grounded column with its entasis measured and its three aspects

pages.title: Grid explained
pages.purpose: A denominator is a ruler, not the drawing; the grid is the box, not the path.
pages.outputs: position and heading, the ruler, the bounding box, the placement grid

pages.title: Volute proof 01
pages.purpose: The exact p-triple spiral under the plant grammar: rails, a cone terminal, a branch.
pages.outputs: an exact rational spine, fitted rails, 2 × offset cone, seagrass branch

pages.title: Cruciform proof 01
pages.purpose: A cross built as two declared junctions and one trunk with section stations.
pages.inputs: trunk and arm widths, fillet radius, section count
pages.outputs: two G1 junctions with measured merges, four cone terminals, section bars

pages.title: Ending fit pass
pages.purpose: The C families attached to one stalk tip at 6 × offset, measured as endings.
pages.inputs: a section from the C-curve table, a stalk offset
pages.outputs: scale, reach, rail clearance, cusp and crossing counts, ending grades

pages.title: Modulated width proof
pages.purpose: A declared width law measured against the constant 2 × band it is not.
pages.inputs: a spine, the width amplitude a, the base width
pages.outputs: width ratio, seam, deviation from the constant band, rail crossings

pages.title: Euler sections
pages.purpose: C curves as exact p-triple Euler polygons with rational rails and a cubic seam.
pages.inputs: one smooth C-curve section, p-triple angle, chord count
pages.outputs: rational polygon, miter rails, cubic drawing, polygon/cubic margins

pages.title: Euler parabola fit
pages.purpose: Interactive endpoint-parabola handle editor plus n^5 error/arclength comparison against true Euler segments.
pages.inputs: drag ends and handles; symmetric/asymmetric studies
pages.outputs: cubic, endpoint parabolas, error and arclength tables

pages.title: Integer cubic Béziers
pages.purpose: Exact integer-control cubic family from Pythagorean triples: chord 2c, arms c, rational tangents, and integer rotations.
pages.outputs: integer control points, tangent, chord, arms, and rotated examples

pages.title: Integer cubic catalogue
pages.purpose: Every primitive triple's ordered arm pairs, signs and exact integer rotation.
pages.outputs: 158 triples, 316 canonical curves, 632 sign variants, the full table

pages.title: Integer cubic offset
pages.purpose: A fitted rail on exact integer controls, labelled fitted.
pages.outputs: the exact offset for reference, the fitted chain, its error

pages.title: Integer G2 mirror chain
pages.purpose: Exact three-piece G2 chain made by mirroring the symmetric integer cubic at both endpoint tangents and scaling by the hypotenuse.
pages.outputs: integer chain controls, join tangents, curvatures, and exact G2 checks

pages.title: Integer G2 drag probe
pages.purpose: Drag the anchors and handles of the scale-1 asymmetric G2 pair; live tangent, curvature, integer and G2 diagnostics.
pages.inputs: drag points on an integer grid
pages.outputs: curve shape and live G1/G2 mismatch report

pages.title: Integer G2 piece
pages.purpose: The scale-1 asymmetric G2 pair as an actual Piece/Trace with cubic spans, SVG rendering, and real piece_clearance.
pages.outputs: rendered piece, clearance report, one declared G2 join

pages.title: Two-parabola S probe
pages.purpose: Two degree-elevated quadratics joined G1; curvature sign reversal makes G2 impossible for a nondegenerate parabola pair.
pages.outputs: elevated cubic controls, join tangent, signed curvatures, G1/G2 verdict

pages.title: Pythagorean families
pages.purpose: All triples up to c=3500 as points: scaling rays, fixed-n parabolas, and the n=2 43.6°→4° sweep.
pages.outputs: points, rays, parabola families, selected integer sequence

pages.title: Triple-tangent chain editor
pages.purpose: Drive the integer chain live: family n, the m range, the node step and the handle rule, with the grid extent predicted before you draw.
pages.inputs: n, m range, step S, uniform handle h or per-node G2 handles
pages.outputs: integer cubic spans, C1 check, curvature jump, extent and a suggested S for a target sheet

pages.title: Levien integer
pages.purpose: Parabola/half/quarter/cubic as exact rails and Levien fits over the integer lattice.
pages.outputs: source, exact rails, Levien fit, integer-hit counts

pages.title: Bounding parabola
pages.purpose: Interactive cubic, area-fitted parabola, hybrid-quadratic bounds, and strip. A separate intersection-bracket sandbox.
pages.inputs: drag two ends and two handles
pages.outputs: fitted parabola, sampled bounds, strip, readout

pages.title: Modulated width
pages.purpose: Variable width along the spine — the former Stage IV; not a parallel offset.
pages.outputs: plain, widening and narrowing ribbons; source link

pages.title: Euler square
pages.purpose: A rounded square whose corners are clothoids, not arcs.
pages.outputs: eight arcs, curvature continuous everywhere

pages.title: Todo
pages.purpose: The checked todo and the provisional curve grades.
pages.outputs: progress, tasks and the grade matrix

pages.title: Log spiral · width
pages.purpose: The equiangular spiral's offset is not a spiral; its scaling is.
pages.inputs: a, b, the offset distance d
pages.outputs: the measured drift of the constant offset, and the exact tapered width

pages.title: p-triple plane
pages.purpose: Hyperbolae are factorisations; a parabola's parallels are involutes, not parabolas.
pages.outputs: integer points, factorisation rows, the exact parallel family

pages.title: Multi-grid design
pages.purpose: Each part declares its own grid; the composite is the lcm and the cost is visible.
pages.inputs: per-part grid denominators and declared seams
pages.outputs: the composite grid and the cell count

pages.title: Tapered stem
pages.purpose: The exact variable width: two log spirals of the same pitch, with the asymmetry measured.
pages.inputs: a, b, the scale k between the rails
pages.outputs: exact rails, width ∝ r, and the terminal seam

pages.title: Composed stem
pages.purpose: Two integer chains joined across a declared 1/5 step; the kink is measured.
pages.inputs: two chain ranges, the link length, the step
pages.outputs: the seam step, the tangent kink, the composite grid

pages.title: Showcase
pages.purpose: Every family of ray and curve on one page, three across, ending in a monstrance.
pages.outputs: 24 numbered panels and the ray fan

pages.title: Dot solver
pages.purpose: One figure per class of dot failure: missing marks, or marks off the curve.
pages.inputs: the six failure classes from the showcase
pages.outputs: measured marks, a chain fit per case, and a PASS/FAIL verdict

pages.title: Showcase effects · clouds
pages.purpose: The effects layer: the cloud set, and the composite Euler clouds to come.
pages.outputs: seven cloud figures, then the composite-curves section

pages.title: Showcase notes
pages.purpose: One note per showcase figure: what is exact, what is fitted, the numbers, the command.
pages.outputs: 16 linked note sections

pages.title: Every named curve
pages.purpose: Generated from NAMED: every named curve and every heart, drawn by the repo.
pages.outputs: 25 named curves, 15 hearts
